_notes: THE BLACK RAM'S CONTACT BURST -- what a landed blow draws on the body it
hit while the form is worn (skills.json black_ram_mode.transform.hit.vfx).
Not a house effect: it belongs to a skill's transform block, which is why
it is cut under Resources/Spells/ with a recipe rather than written
straight into Resources/Vfx/ the way slash_arc and impact_burst are
(docs/ART_PIPELINE.md 5c states that ownership rule).
THE SHEET IS GENERATED, NOT DELIVERED, and that is the one way this recipe
differs from every other one here. `tools/make_contact_fx.py --form-sheet`
draws ram_impact_8f.png from polar arithmetic, the same tool and the same
arithmetic the house's two contact sequences come from. So the provenance
is in two halves: this recipe explains the CUT, and that function explains
the SHEET. Re-run both and the bytes come back.
IT IS A PLACEHOLDER AND SAYS SO. Polar arithmetic can describe a hard
shard burst; it cannot draw a ram. What it delivers is the WEIGHT the
brief asked for -- bigger, darker, harder-edged and two frames longer than
the house burst -- against the day a commissioned sheet replaces it, at
which point only the geometry below changes. Two earlier passes were
rejected before this one: a soft continuous ring (read as a smoke ring)
and a broken soft ring with petals (read as a flower). The third is
hard-edged wedges with a lobed black mass at their root, biased along the
direction of the blow. It reads as a shard burst rather than as anything
ram-shaped, and the two 'horn' arcs behind the mass do not read as horns.
8 CELLS OVER 2x4 at 320 square, which divides exactly -- a uniform grid is
right and no rects are needed. Eight rather than the house's six because
the read being sold is a heavy thing settling rather than a light one
snapping off, and the last two frames are the settle.
keyed: false. THE ALPHA IS AUTHORED IN THE SHEET, which is the one house
convention this pack breaks on purpose: ART_PIPELINE 2's luminance key
exists because a glow has no clean edge, and the most SOLID part of this
sheet is its darkest. Keyed from luminance, the black mass would be the
most transparent thing in the frame.
NO sequence: the eight cells are the eight frames, one for one. Nothing
here needs a hold or a spin -- the wedges already ease out, and the peak
(f3, the widest spread with the mass still solid) carries its own weight.
